title: Geo capacity matrix and stakeholder orchestration for Dedicated reservations
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Summary: Build a coordinated go-to-market plan and operational matrix for launching Dedicated reservation SKUs across three new regions (eu-west-3, ap-south-1, ca-central-1). This ticket consolidates the SKU matrix (instance families, commit tiers, burst policies), release notes sequencing, console UX changes, billing hooks, and stakeholder playbook for launch day and first 30 days.

Context: Multiple regional launches are on the critical path for our Q2 revenue targets. Engineering has validated runtime compatibility for the proposed instance families but needs a final SKU matrix and rollout sequencing to enable capacity provisioning. Sales and Partner Ops require clear reservation bundles and FAQs. The Console team needs a small set of UI copy + telemetry hooks to display per-region reservation quotas.

Goals:
- Agree on region-by-region SKU matrix (families, vCPU/GPU tiers, commit lengths) and a fallback policy for capacity shortfalls.
- Produce release notes copy and sequencing that minimizes support load (feature flagging and staged exposure).
- Coordinate billing/pricing updates and invoices for reserved commitments.
- Create a single stakeholder runbook (ops, sales, support, legal) for launch day and first 30-day cadence.
acceptance_criteria: SKU matrix documented and approved by Eng, Finance, and Sales
Release notes and customer-facing FAQ drafted and staged in the release pipeline
Console reservation purchase flow updated with regional SKU labels and telemetry hooks
Billing integration validated end-to-end in sandbox for reservation charges
Playbook published in Drive and reviewed by all stakeholders with signoff from Support and Legal

decisions: Soft-launch in eu-west-3 with two commit tiers (6mo, 12mo) before full roll in ap-south-1 and ca-central-1
Default fallback policy: automatic routing to hosted pool with customer opt-out; explicit billing credit applied for overflow cases
Offer a single, unified reservation product in Console labeled 'Dedicated Reservations (preview)' to avoid SKU confusion during rollout
risks: GPU procurement uncertainty in ap-south-1 could delay or limit SKUs available for sale
Billing reconciliation differences between reservation commitments and metered usage may create customer invoicing disputes
Console UI changes rushed late could cause purchase flow regressions and increased support tickets
